svg.title: EPoSe: quorum, qualification, recipient rotation and service reward
svg.desc: q_E = ceil(2 * min(9, N_E - 1) / 3); a_(s,r) = |A_(s,r) intersection C_(s,r)|. s in Q_E if and only if sum from r=0 to 2 of indicator[a_(s,r) >= q_E] >= 2. pi_(E+1)(h) = rank_H(Q_E)[(h - start(E+1)) mod |Q_E|]. R_EPoSe(h) = floor(subsidy(h) * 1000 / 10000). The quorum expression assumes N_E >= 1. Rotation requires |Q_E| > 0 and uses a zero-based list index. N_E is the frozen member count; C_(s,r) is the subject-excluding committee; A_(s,r) contains unique valid signed attestations; Q_E contains qualified Service Nodes; H is the domain-separated consensus hash. Indicator is one if its condition is true, zero otherwise.

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #ffb000; stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-linecap: square
